newsitem.title: UK: Group 4 wins 33 million stg UK prisons contract.
newsitem.headline: Group 4 wins 33 million stg UK prisons contract.

text.p: Privately owned Group 4 Securitas BV has won a further five-year contract worth 33 million stg to manage and operate Wolds prison in Yorkshire, Richard Tilt, the director general of Britain's prison service, said on Friday.
Group 4's present five-year contract expires next April.
Tilt said in a statement that Group 4 had been awarded the extension on the grounds of value for money and its considerable success so far in meeting tough performance targets.
Wolds holds on average 340 inmates. The prison service said recent research showed that private prisons generally achieve significant cost savings over publicly managed jails.
